description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Etipola Mapa Gunathilaka Mudiyanselage Rohana Kumara as a member of the Matale Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Matale Municipal Council) due to a member's failure to attend meetings. The content is specifically about the electoral process for a local authority, including the nomination of a replacement by a political party and the official declaration of the new member by the Returning Officer. This falls directly under the "Elections Gazettes" category, which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
